segment: The 7z archive codec is repaired and published; it had never worked in this composition

the_defect.the_symptom: every 7z archive the product was asked for was refused with archive_codec_unavailable; the profile of 2026-11-05 carries it at messages 1989 and 1995, so the capability never worked in this composition
the_defect.the_reason: the codec worker is started with the interpreter of the COMMITTED dependency generation, but the helper that picks that interpreter demanded that the PARENT process already carries that generation's site-packages on its own sys.path. The launcher deliberately starts the product without an ambient PYTHONPATH, and the dependency is activated only when a generation changes. A normal installation therefore never satisfies the condition, and the codec refused even though the committed generation carries py7zr 1.1.0.

the_evidence.the_committed_generation_carries_the_dep: py7zr 1.1.0 is present in the committed generation 8e0c92ce... inside the composition
the_evidence.the_child_can_import_it: the isolated child (-I) imports py7zr 1.1.0 on its own
the_evidence.the_parent_is_not_activated: the gateway process does not carry that site-packages on sys.path
the_evidence.the_consequence: the parent-side check refused a generation that is complete, so the capability was unreachable

the_defect.the_fix: the requirement is now that the committed generation CARRIES the dependency, which is the actual condition for the child to succeed. The parent-side activation requirement is dropped: the child is isolated anyway and the committed generation is the only thing it can load.

the_verification.after_the_fix: encode_7z returns an archive of 162 bytes with the true 7z signature 7z bc af 27 1c, and decode_7z reads it back as [('a.txt', False, b'hello'), ('b.txt', False, b'world')]
the_verification.on_the_serving_composition: the same call in the published composition produces the true 7z signature and reads back
the_verification.the_scope: the change is confined to the selection of the worker interpreter; the codec itself, its limits and its refusals are untouched

the_publication.the_bench: the bundle was published on a bench copy first; the receipt digest matched the live one (3c21ee45...)
the_publication.the_live_result: published onto the serving composition; the receipt carries 186 layers and the new layer
the_publication.the_receiver: was stopped for the publication and started again: one process, pid 49959, Telegram connected, the three profiles intact, both profile databases intact

not_repeated: no case request was sent in this segment; the capability is verified by a direct call into the published composition, and the cases that need it are executed next under their own admission
